title: Did Asobo fix the Pushback Bug? #msfs2024 #flightsim
description: In this video, we take a closer look at the latest sim update from Asobo Studio to see if they have finally fixed the pushback bug that has been plaguing Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 users. The pushback procedure is a crucial part of ground services and airport operations, and many players have been waiting for a fix to improve their overall flight simulator experience. We examine the changes made to ground handling, including tug operations, to determine if Asobo has successfully addressed the issue. With the latest update, we put the new pushback system to the test to see if it now functions as intended, providing a more realistic and immersive experience for players. If you're interested in msfs pushback and want to know if the latest update is worth downloading, be sure to watch this video to find out.
